resources.string: You don\'t have any Secret Santa event.\nCreate one and start enjoying all the features!
All events have ended.\nCreate a new one!
The date is not valid. It cannot be in the past or more than 6 months in the future.
The configured exclusions are not valid. It is not possible to run the draw.
You can add participants in different ways (not exclusive). Select a group, search for users and/or share the invitation link.

Don\'t worry, if you are not sure who will participate in the event, you can skip this step and add members later.
(select the event > edit)
Set up exclusions between the participating members.
Not sure which exclusions there should be?

Don\'t worry, create the event and you can configure the exclusions between members later.
(select the event > edit)

The event has ended.
You can view the details, but it can no longer be updated.

The event will be automatically deleted 30 days after the deadline.
The draw has not been run yet. Do you want to do it now?
The event ended without the draw being run… Create a new one!
Once the draw has been run, it will no longer be possible to edit its conditions. If you want to make changes, now is the time!
Chat anonymously with %s. Send them clues about who you are or ask them questions about the gift while keeping the surprise.
Your Secret Santa wants to ask you things and/or give you clues about who they are. Chat anonymously with them.
Share a wishlist and help your Secret Santa
Great, you have shared a wishlist with your Secret Santa. You have earned 20 points.
When sharing a wishlist with your Secret Santa, a copy of the list\'s current state will be sent; any changes you make in the future will not be visible and may harm the experience.

This is a read-only list: it cannot be edited or marked as purchased.
Important: the content is indicative and may not match the current state of the original wishlist.

This is a read-only list. You can unshare it or change it, although it is not recommended.
Important: modifying or deleting it will carry a points penalty.

Are you sure you want to change the wishlist you shared?
Your Secret Santa may already have accessed it, and the change could be confusing!

Keep in mind that this action carries a 5-point penalty.

Are you sure you want to stop sharing this wishlist?
Your Secret Santa may already have accessed it, and it is sure to be very helpful!

Keep in mind that this action carries a 20-point penalty.
Remember that this is an anonymous chat; try not to reveal information that could identify you and spoil the surprise!
They will be automatically deleted 30 days after they expire.
Too many events and can\'t find what you\'re looking for? Use the search to find the Secret Santa you want:
In this section you will find the interests and/or hobbies the user has made public to help guide and inspire gift ideas.
Oops! User %s has no public interests. Send an anonymous message and ask them to add some!

Can\'t think of anything? We\'ll help you!
Based on the interests and hobbies, our artificial intelligence will suggest ideas for you.
The AI suggestions feature will generate a list of 5 ideas each time you use it. The first use is free; after that, it will cost you 10 points each time you use it.
